title: Old agreement with non-human beings from the Truman–Eisenhower era

tellings.quote: that that is the nature of at least one very old agreement um sometime in the Truman and Eisenhower era uh that was arrived at.

plain: There is said to be at least one "very old agreement" between the US government and non-human beings, reached sometime in the Truman and Eisenhower years. Matthew Brown, who presents himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels this as something passed on to him, and links it to claims of alien hybrid breeding programs. If true, it would mean presidents of the 1940s and 50s made a deal with beings from somewhere else.
